sources.description: Top-level project README. Defines the two-package architecture (basement + gateway), lists all agent examples, and provides the Quick Start. The single most important orientation document for any learner of this framework.

Full API reference for the Basement core package. Covers the think-act-observe agent loop, @tool decorator, @hook decorator, skills system, permissions, MCP integration, ToolRouter, and all key classes (AgentRuntime, ToolSpec, HookEvent). Primary learning material for the core framework.

Full API reference for the Gateway orchestration package. Covers GatewayCore, RuleEngine, ActionExecutor, SessionStore, SharedHistory, AsyncCompactPipeline, and WebSocket server. Explains the rule system (@check decorator, sequential vs parallel, actions: CONTINUE/RESPOND/INJECT/COMPACT/PRE_TOOL). The definitive reference for the gateway layer.

The core agent loop implementation (run_agent_loop). Implements the think-act-observe cycle: add user message, fire ON_TURN_START, PRE_LLM_CALL, stream LLM, execute tools with hooks, fire ON_TURN_END, flush mutations. Essential for understanding how the framework actually executes at runtime.

GatewayCore implementation. Wires together session management, rule engine, action executor, stage machine, compact pipeline, and agent loop. Shows how handle_message() orchestrates a full per-turn flow including stage transitions, preloads, filler text, and streaming output.

RuleEngine implementation. Shows how sequential and parallel check modes work, priority ordering, short-circuit on first non-CONTINUE result in sequential mode, and fail-open exception handling. Compact and highly readable source for understanding the rule evaluation model.

The @tool decorator. Shows how JSON Schema is auto-generated from Python type hints, how docstrings become tool descriptions, and how ToolSpec is created. Critical for understanding how tools are defined in this framework.

Demo gateway README. Showcases every Gateway feature: layers, stages, Filter/Respond/Inject/StageTransition/Compact actions, ctx.data inter-layer passing, stage preloads. Serves as a concrete worked example of the full gateway feature set.

Lina TMR agent gateway README. A production-scale reference implementation: 7-stage conversation flow, 4 rule checks, 16 tools, 3 skills, interrupt handling, compact configuration, troubleshooting guide. Demonstrates the framework's real-world capability and complexity.
Demo agent system prompt (BOSON.md). The minimal example of a BOSON.md file — defines tools, skills, and style instructions. Shows the convention for writing agent system prompts.
Gateway package manifest. Shows version (0.3.0), dependencies (basement, websockets>=12.0), Python requirement (>=3.11), and pytest configuration. Useful for environment setup context.
Basement package manifest. Shows version, dependencies, and build configuration. Useful for installation and environment setup context.
Concrete example of a @check rule using Filter and Respond actions. Shows how to write a guard-layer rule that blocks spam and returns fixed greetings.
Concrete example of a stateful orchestrator rule using StageTransition and Compact actions, including inter-layer ctx.data passing. Demonstrates stage transition logic from a real rule.
Production-grade stage transition detector rule. Shows keyword-based + LLM-fallback transition detection pattern used in a real multi-stage sales agent.
Stage configuration for the Lina gateway. Defines initial_stage, stage tool/skill assignments, and allowed transitions. Shows the declarative stage machine configuration format.
Demo agent config.yaml. Minimal example of LLM configuration (provider, model, temperature, max_tokens) and feature flags.
